QuestInfo.name: Finding the Instructor
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #b#p313##k in #b#m10002000##k wants to test whether I'm worthy of receiving his teachings.
QuestInfo.1: #m10002000#'s #b#p313# gave me a letter to deliver to the #b#p319##k, who I should be able to find somewhere in #b#m10002070##k. He said I'd learn the rest of the details there.
QuestInfo.2: In #b#m10002070##k, I met the #b#p319##k. He said he would test whether I was worthy of making the 2nd job advancement. Great! I told him I was ready for anything!

0.0: So... What do you think? Do you want to get even stronger than you are right now? Pass a simple test and I can help you do just that... Do you want to do it?

yes.0: Good... You look strong, all right, but I need to see if you're the real deal. The test isn't terribly difficult, and you should be able to pass it. Here, take my letter first. Make sure you don't lose it.
yes.1: Please get this letter to the #b#p319##k around #b#m10002070##k near #m10002000#. He's acting as instructor in my place...
yes.2: Get him the letter and he'll test you in my stead. He'll give you all the details about it. Best of luck to you...

no.0: Really? It will help you out a great deal on your journey if you get stronger quickly... If you change your mind in the future, please feel free to come back. Know that I'll make you much more powerful than you are right now...

1.0: Hmmm... It is definitely the letter from #b#p313##k... So you came all the way here to take the test and make the 2nd job advancement as a Magician?
